messages:
ana: Postmortem follow-up quick decision: propose a disclosure ladder (public recap -> tech brief -> on-request deep pack) and a "pattern watchlist" that auto-notifies when similar incidents recur. Agree?

dave: Agree on ladder. Can we keep the public recap one-sentence + link? legal flagged long apologies before.

ana: typo: ana :) Public recap = 24h, one sentence + link to details. Tech brief = 72h when impact > threshold (we'll define). Deep pack = on-request only, requires intake form + approvals.

zoe: For pattern watchlist suggest thresholds: >=2 similar in 21 days OR >=3 in 60 days. If hit, tech brief includes: "pattern watchlist: yes" and assign remediation owner with a provisional ETA.

rahul: Ops-bot, can you auto-add a "pattern-watch" label and ping eng-leads when thresholds hit?

ops-bot: Yes. I can run a nightly similarity job if eng-ml exposes a scoring endpoint. Will post in-thread when label applied.

ana: Action items (owners + due_ts): 1) ana -> public recap template to on-call runbook (due_ts:2460003000) 2) zoe -> finalize thresholds with eng-ml + signature spec (due_ts:2460009000) 3) dave -> intake form skeleton for deep pack + approvals list (due_ts:2460018000) 4) infra -> expose incident tags to ops-bot (owner: infra, due_ts:2460006000)

zoe: Wording suggestion for public recap: "We experienced a disruption to <service> starting <time>. Service restored at <time>. More details: <link>" Keep it neutral and customer-focused.

dave: I'll draft intake and approvals. Legal: avoid liability language; stick to facts and remediation steps.

ana: I'll convert these into the action tracker and close this thread after owners ack.

ops-bot: Noted. I'll post when nightly job runs and if pattern found.

zoe: Acked.

dave: Acked.
